messages:
alex: Hey team — PTAL on <https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1234|runtime#1234>. I pushed fixes for the flaky kv allocator test and added a smoke script. Addressed all review comments. Need one more approve so ops can pick a canary slot today.

maria: On it, grabbing a quick local run now.

sam: Skimming — left a tiny nit re: log level on the allocator fallback path. Can we drop it to `debug`? Otherwise looks good.

alex: Good catch, addressed in `fix/log-level` commit (pushed). Also added the smoke command I ran:
```bash
./scripts/run_smoke.sh --tests kv_allocator --quick
```
Outputs were green locally (no flake).

priya: Ran the smoke in gce-test. Passes, latency looks stable (median ~12ms). :thumbsup:

maria: LGTM from me. Keen to get this into canary before EOD.

sam: LGTM too. Thanks for the quick follow-ups.

deploy-bot: Canary window available at 2024-05-12 18:30 UTC — slot reserved and added to the deploy queue. (queue position: 3)

alex: Thanks everyone — I'll merge once CI is green and then ping infra if the queue doesn't move. 👍
